title: AQUILA 2026.11.11.2
notes:
- Drag across Channel Rack rows to select channels. The selection box and row highlights show the selection as you drag. Press Delete to remove the selected channels together.
- Use Mute or Solo on a selected Channel Rack row to apply it to the group. Adjust Pitch, Volume, or Pan together while keeping the relative settings between channels.
- Hold Ctrl and drag to reorder a Channel Rack row or move the selected channels together. An insertion line shows where the rows will land. Undo and Redo preserve the notes and instruments attached to each channel.
- Fixed the Playlist audio timing editor closing or placing an extra clip when you clicked or dragged inside the editor.
- Fixed distorted PAT and SONG labels and sharpened the Play, Pause, and Stop icons. Updated the AQUILA app icon for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
